title: The mailbox is starving. I am not.
message:
sho.islam0311@proton.me — you know the address. I know you know the address.

Thousands of you, every day. Episodes playing. Bugs getting squashed. Downloads downloading. And what lands in the mailbox? Last month: three emails. One was me, checking the inbox still exists. One was a scam. The third was my domain bill going UP.

Your silence is funding exactly none of this, and yet here we all are, together, pretending that's normal.

I have started taking the quiet personally. Every empty day, one more unexplained flicker appears somewhere in the UI. I won't tell you where. That's the fun part.

Fix it. Send one bug report. One feature idea. One unhinged rant about the color of a button — I will frame it and hang it above my desk. sho.islam0311@proton.me. Feed the thing before it starts feeding.

(Still looking for kind souls to help build Discord & Telegram. And the math hasn't changed: if 3/4 of you tossed $5/month, this site stops depending on my sleeping schedule.)

— the thing that answers the mailbox, forever waiting
